title: FIG-MAC: A Fine-grained Inspiration Graph Empowered Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generation (ASHG) leveraging large language models (LLMs) aims to harness their strengths in knowledge integration, logical reasoning, and text generation for efficiently producing innovative, verifiable scientific hypotheses. However, existing approaches face three critical limitations: (i) insufficient fine-grained knowledge representation, as unstructured context impairs LLM comprehension and reasoning; (ii) lack of knowledge evolution traceability, constraining the generation of innovative cross-domain conjectures; (iii) absence of human-inspired and role-specialized multi-agent collaboration, failing to leverage the efficient innovation mechanisms arising from cognitive diversity and division of labor among expert roles to complete the full ASHG-evaluation loop. translated_title: FIG-MAC：一种用于自动科学假设生成的细粒度灵感图赋能多智能体协作框架
translated_abstract: 利用大语言模型（LLM）的自动科学假设生成（ASHG）旨在发挥其在知识整合、逻辑推理和文本生成方面的优势，以高效产出具有创新性且可验证的科学假设。然而，现有方法面临三个关键局限：(i) 细粒度知识表示不足，非结构化上下文削弱了LLM的理解与推理能力；(ii) 缺乏知识演化可追溯性，限制了创新性跨领域猜想的产生；(iii) 缺乏受人类启发的、角色专业化的多智能体协作，未能利用认知多样性与专家角色分工所带来的高效创新机制来完成完整的“假设生成-评估”闭环。为解决这些局限，我们提出了细粒度灵感图赋能的多智能体协作框架（FIG-MAC），包括……
tldr: 该论文提出FIG-MAC框架，通过细粒度灵感图实现更精细的知识表示与知识演化可追溯，并结合受人类启发的角色专业化多智能体协作机制，完成科学假设的自动生成与评估闭环。
